subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Before the map, trees were part of the background.”?
options: After it opened, the grass began to grow back.
After the tags, they began saying "camphor tree" and "maple."
A safer street began with people carefully recording what they saw.
After the map, people began noticing them as individuals.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「After it opened, the grass began to grow back.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「After the tags, they began saying 'camphor tree' and 'maple.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A safer street began with people carefully recording what they saw.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Before the map, trees were part of the background. After the map, people began noticing them as individuals.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Before the map, trees were part of the background. After the map, people began noticing them as individuals.」，答案為「After the map, people began noticing them as individuals.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「After the map, people began noticing them as individuals.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
